01 — Introduction

Hi, I'm
Natalie.

I'm an Austin-based creator known for personality-driven comedy, cultural storytelling, and relatable takes on everyday life.

From immigrant-parent POVs and family dynamics to food, fashion, travel, relationships, and lifestyle, I create content that feels conversational, recognizable, and highly shareable.

My audience comes for the humor and stays for my personality, which makes brand integrations feel like part of the content instead of traditional advertising.
